factors.factor: Temporal parameter credit within memory ceiling
factors.literature: UORO uses rank-one parameter sensitivity; one-packet truncation cannot claim unbiased long-range credit.
factors.projectStatus: One-packet write learning improves a narrow matched forecast. Rank-one longer credit implemented and tested, but four-pass run loses persistence and reduces answer retention to 5/10; candidate rejected.
factors.gap: Stable long-range credit and causal forecast/retention benefit

memoryEstimate.limitation: Arithmetic estimate only; optimizer, activations, temporary tensors and raw encoders excluded. No UORO runtime benchmark.

factors.literature: Persistence is the standard forecast reference (skill score, MASE). Learned predictors can beat copy-last-frame when they predict residuals from the current input (PredNet roughly 2.5x lower MSE).
factors.comparisonLimits: Pixel/weather domains, not pooled MiniCPM embeddings
factors.gap: Whether the pooled 100 ms target has predictable variance beyond persistence

factors.literature: Self-initiated timing fits a leaky noisy accumulator to threshold; dopamine ramps modulate the hazard of acting; streaming systems trigger by accumulated informativeness.
factors.comparisonLimits: Biology concerns motor timing, not speech initiation
factors.gap: Learned thresholds and urge without an LLM

factors.literature: Decoders must beat a null built without the true state, survive identification and control tasks; probe accuracy is not evidence of use.
factors.gap: Validated protocol for a self-reporting recurrent agent

factors.literature: Self-generated latent targets need stop-gradient/EMA or SIGReg; EMA can produce a collapse phase where loss falls but features are useless.
